operation_notes: Both desks face the white wall. The owned UPLIFT top stays 42×30 in; the 140×60 cm secondary desktop has one ALEX pedestal on the left.
A nominal 50 cm body route connects entry and rear door in the working and simultaneous 45 cm chair-pullback poses. The 55 cm route test does not pass.
Use the clothes dresser with the main chair tucked toward its desk: about 79 cm remains in front of fully open drawers in the working pose, versus 34 cm with 45 cm pullback.
Three GREJIG racks are a provisional shoe-storage idea inside the existing closet. Its interior and hanging clearance were not recorded; the door and cupboard remain accessible.
The revised lamp location leaves a nominal 11 cm gap to the desk foot. Its exact U-base and the full cat-tree branch span remain unverified; check actual tight fits on site.
fit_review_note: These are indicative model checks, with typical 5–12 cm scan-outline uncertainty. Review tight fits on site; this is not an accessibility certification.
